description:
[Servers] Status of a map drawing job. `status` is `queued`, `downloading` (map file), `generating` (our own game server building a procedural
map - several minutes), `rendering`, `done` or `failed` (`error` says why; failed downloads are retried
after 6 h, 24 h, then weekly - `next_attempt_at`). When done, `map` carries the image URLs and summary. Poll a create_map job: queued -> downloading/generating -> rendering -> done (or failed with the reason).

job_id.description: The job id `POST /maps` returned (the map key).

name: get_map_job
title: Status of a map drawing job
